articles.title: Senegalese MPs move to clip presidential powers as tensions mount
articles.description: The proposed changes agreed by a majority of MPs sparked protests outside parliament.

articles.title: Pakistani strikes kill at least 28 civilians in Afghanistan, UN says
articles.description: Pakistan claims it was targeting militants near its border, but the Taliban government calls it an "atrocity".

articles.title: Putin makes rare admission of fuel shortages caused by Ukrainian strikes
articles.description: The Russian president acknowledged Ukraine's attacks were "obviously creating problems" but denied the shortages were "critical".

articles.title: Teyana Taylor's tears and Lauryn Hill tribute steal show at BET Awards
articles.description: Taylor had an emotional reaction to being presented with the Icon of the Year award by Janet Jackson.
